scenes.title: The Knock in the Lamp

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm rages outside while you hear rhythmic knocking from the locked lamp room.

cues.speaker: Old Tom
cues.text: Never open that door. The lamp room is sealed for a reason.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: He stands guard as the sound grows louder, then suddenly stops.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The knocking stops. What do you do?

scenes.question: The knocking stops. What do you do?

scenes.title: Open the door

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You push the heavy door open into the dark room.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: A figure stands there, holding a lantern that casts long shadows.

cues.speaker: The Stranger
cues.text: You look tired but alert. The knocking stops instantly.

cues.speaker: The Stranger
cues.text: I am not here to harm you, keeper.

cues.speaker: The Stranger
cues.text: I only need the key to the light.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The stranger asks for the light key. What do you do?

scenes.question: The stranger asks for the light key. What do you do?

scenes.title: Call for Old Tom

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm rages outside while you hear rhythmic knocking from the locked lamp room.

cues.speaker: Old Tom
cues.text: Never open it. I know what lives there.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You call for him. Old Tom bursts in, but the stranger is gone.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Only wet footprints lead to the stairs.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The stranger is gone. What do you do?

scenes.question: The stranger is gone. What do you do?

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The stranger takes the key and leaves the lamp burning bright.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm rages outside as the heavy door slams shut forever.

cues.speaker: Old Tom
cues.text: You are safe now. The light will guide you home.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm fades into silence as the light steadies the waves.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm fades into silence as the light steadies the waves.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You slam the door shut, trapping the stranger inside the dark room.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm outside finally quiets to a gentle hush.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: But from within, a slow scratching sound begins to rise.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Old Tom stands nearby, watching you with a knowing look.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The scratching stops. The room is silent once more.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You realize the stranger was never a person at all.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The lamp room is empty, and the storm has passed.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You are the keeper now, alone with the light.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The story of the lamp is finally over.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You follow the wet footprints down the dark stairs until the floor gives way.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: A trapdoor opens into the churning sea below where the Stranger was waiting.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm rages above while the water pulls the Stranger down into the deep.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The knocking stops forever as the Stranger disappears beneath the waves.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You stand alone in the lamp room with the storm raging outside.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The storm rages outside and the Stranger is gone. What do you do?

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Dawn breaks over the stormy sea as you stand guard at the door.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: The stranger never returns. The knocking has stopped.

cues.speaker: Old Tom
cues.text: You've been a good keeper. But you were never there.

cues.speaker: Old Tom
cues.text: The footprints were my own. I was testing your resolve.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: He smiles and walks away into the morning light.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: You are the silent keeper now. The lamp stands alone.
